title: Radial invariance forces G(t, α) = tγ(α) on the coordinate square
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, M, N ⊆ ℝ^P, p ∈ ℝ^P, ρ, r₀, s ∈ ℝ, F : ℝ^P → ℝ², G : ℝ² → ℝ^P and γ : ℝ → ℝ^P; put J := (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), I := (−s, s) and R := {w ∈ ℝ² : w₀ ∈ J, w₁ ∈ I}. Assume 0 < s < r₀; N is open and N ⊆ B_ρ(p); t·x ∈ M whenever x ∈ M ∩ B_ρ(p), t > 0 and t·x ∈ B_ρ(p); G is continuous on R; M ∩ N = G(R); F(G(w)) = w for every w ∈ R; and for every α ∈ I: ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, G(r₀, α) = r₀γ(α), and F(tγ(α)) = (t, α) for every t > 0. Then G(w) = w₀·γ(w₁) for every w ∈ R, and M ∩ N = {tγ(α) : t ∈ J, α ∈ I}, the image of J × I under (t, α) ↦ tγ(α).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ρ r₀ s : ℝ) (F : Euclid P → Euclid 2) (G : Euclid 2 → Euclid P) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → N ⊆ ball p ρ → (∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball p ρ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t • x ∈ ball p ρ → t • x ∈ M) → ContinuousOn G {w : Euclid 2 | w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ∧ w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s} → M ∩ N = G '' {w : Euclid 2 | w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ∧ w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s} → (∀ w : Euclid 2, w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) → w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s → F (G w) = w) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ G !₂[r₀, α] = r₀ • γ α ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → F (t • γ α) = !₂[t, α]) → (∀ w : Euclid 2, w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) → w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s → G w = w 0 • γ (w 1)) ∧ M ∩ N = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s)
